cuecs.title: Provision and remove staff
cuecs.statement: Approve each staff member's access before adding them, change it when their job changes, and deactivate them in OpenClear (or in the bank's identity provider) by the bank's own deadline when they leave.

cuecs.statement: Treat reports, exports and check images downloaded from OpenClear as confidential: store them encrypted, share them only with those who need them, and delete them when no longer needed.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear limits downloads to the customer's own accounts and records each export.

cuecs.title: Train against fraud and social engineering
cuecs.statement: Train the people who issue checks and decide exceptions on check fraud and social engineering, such as fake requests to change payment details or to pay an item.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear shows the information a decision needs, but can't judge whether the person deciding has been trained.

cuecs.title: Test integration changes
cuecs.statement: Test changes to the customer's own integration (issue-file exports, API clients) in the sandbox before using them in production.

cuecs.title: Encrypt storage at rest
cuecs.statement: Encrypt the database, file storage (check images, uploads, archives) and backups at rest, and record how in OPENCLEAR_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_ATTESTATION.

cuecs.title: Manage the keys
cuecs.statement: Generate the signing keys and the field-encryption key outside the image, keep them in a secret store, restrict who can read them, and rotate them on the host's schedule.
cuecs.complements: OpenClear refuses to start in production with development keys, versions its encryption key and re-encrypts on rotation.
